However, `f` itself is created before any conditional logic involving `symlinkDestination`, and its value remains the same regardless of what `symlinkDestination` contains.

The value of `f` used at line 45 does not depend on the value of `symlinkDestination` because `f` is initialized independently of `symlinkDestination`.
